description: Follow a hosted public base for future updates. Requires a personal account or personal API key. Following grants no private access. Up to 50 hosted public bases per account. Updates show the latest published version of each document, not a version history. Repeated publication of the same version creates no update. Each read checks current publication. Unfollowing removes all notices for that base. Responses use private, no-store. No email or push messages.

base_id.description: The hosted base ID: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
